remarks: **THANK YOU FOR YOUR INTEREST: Seller requests highest/best offers by 6pm Monday 8/11/2025.** Exciting opportunity at the highly-desirable Chesterfield Condominium, a luxurious gated complex with attended guardhouse. Set in the most convenient and central location in Stamford, this complex offers swimming pools, landscaped grounds and a lovely environment - plus immediate access to Ridgeway Center shopping. This much-loved end-unit Townhouse is filled with sunshine and is a happy, feel-good home that you will love calling your own. Enter the vaulted ceiling foyer, and experience the spacious atmosphere with a freshly painted interior. The large, dine-in kitchen has a vaulted ceiling, window and skylight, and has been impeccably maintained - the counters, solid wood cabinetry, tile floor, and appliances all glisten and reflect the careful maintenance and pride of ownership of this home. The flexible layout of the main level also has an oversized LR w/ fireplace and a large dining room or office/den, both with hardwood floors, and half bath. Sliding doors open to a private back deck that is surrounded by landscaping. The second floor has brand-new carpeting, a very generously-sized primary suite with a king-sized bedroom, three double closets, dressing room/vanity area and a skylit full bath. The full-size laundry room includes the washer and dryer plus storage space. NEW central heating/cooling 2024 per seller. This home has benefitted from very careful, thoughtful upkeep
